checked_scope: Full source read for scope; positive source verification limited to unconditional Sections 1-4. All review additions verified: pure-profile linear feasibility equivalence, Nash implication and coordination nonconverse, enlarged step-size absorption interval and bound, and optimization of dominant-action constant. External analytic finite-generation and conditional Section 6 are not certified.
checks_performed: Read complete pinned manuscript and contribution metadata; actual manuscript SHA256 matches provenance and review metadata; confirmed report retains conditional/open scope.
Verified exact update telescoping, loss/payoff normalization, weak-dominance gap potential, initial step, singleton-action case, and static-payoff lower-bound integral.
Re-derived optimistic KL identity, Pinsker/Young constants, opponent product-TV half factor, feedback sums and aggregate-regret nonnegativity without assuming individual regrets are nonnegative.
Averaged each pure-profile LP row under the independent product mixed profile to establish exact equivalence; checked no comparator-variable products enter the LP.
Substituted a unilateral deviation from p to prove Nash necessity and explicitly summed the two coordination-game pure rows to derive impossible 2>=4, verifying nonconverse.

Independently solved the unrelaxed stability inequality for E_T and substituted the individual feedback bound; checked strict eta<1/[sqrt(2)(N-1)], source-step equality recovery and divergence at the absorption boundary.
Minimized e^eta/(1-e^-eta) using t=e^eta>1, obtaining unique t=2 and value four.
limitations: External bibliography and empirical/background attribution were not independently reverified in this audit; approval covers the exact supplied manuscript and the mathematical scope described.
No formal proof-assistant verification or independent human verification; numerical spot checks, where present, supplement analytic checking rather than establish general results.
No claim that the catalogue open problem is solved or that the refinement has priority over external literature.

The external analytic finite-generation theorem, its historical dependencies and the conditional real-exponential-field decision hypothesis underlying Sections 5-6 are not certified; the report explicitly confines support to Sections 1-4.
significance: The review turns the aggregate-comparator hypothesis into a finite LP with a concrete game excluding universal applicability, and proves a strictly larger interval of sufficient step sizes with explicit horizon-uniform regret bounds.
